a.xlink:title: Converts a given virtual address into a physical address.
Fetches the first level page tables (tbbr0, tbbr1) from the RAM.
Checks if the TLB entries should be invalidated and if so, it clears the cache.
Returns the page table that will be used for address translation (boundary register C2 C0 2).
Retrieves a given page from a page table by a given virtual address.
Verifies page access (calls a chain of functions that validate the access).
Returns the physical address of a given page table.
Returns the set boundary type that determines the use of either TTB0 or TTB1.
Returns the raw value of the page.
Verifies access privileges when accessing a page (virtual address).
Returns privileged mode page access restrictions (R/RW).
Checks if the CPU is in a privileged mode.
Returns the current mode of the CPU.
